PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (18.0, 12.0, 22.0),
    "L_in":    (0.18, 0.15, 0.35),
    "gmid_c":  (12.0, 8.0, 18.0),
    "L_c":     (0.18, 0.15, 0.4),
    "gmid_bc": (5.0, 3.0, 9.0),
    "gmid_ld": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),
    "L_ld":    (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),
    "gmid_t":  (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),
    "L_t":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "Itail":   (72e-6, 40e-6, 74e-6),
    "R1":      (60e3, 20e3, 150e3),
    "ratio":   (0.118, 0.108, 0.13),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 0.3e-12)
    vdd = 1.8
    It = p["Itail"]; Ih = It / 2.0

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Ih, vds=0.3, vsb=0.35)
    m1c = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], Ih, vds=0.3, vsb=0.65)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], Ih, vds=0.9)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], It, vds=0.35)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], iref, vds=mt.vgs)
    mbc = lut.size("n", p["gmid_bc"], p["L_c"], iref, vds=0.6, vsb=mb.vgs)

    R1 = p["R1"]; Rf = p["ratio"] * R1

    n = Netlist("vin1 vin2 vout vcm vdd vss ibias")
    # bias stack: ibias -> MBC diode -> nb -> MB diode -> vss ; ibias node = cascode gate
    n.dev("MBC", "ibias", "ibias", "nb", "vss", mbc)
    n.dev("MB", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "nb", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "vn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M1C", "vout", "ibias", "x1", "vss", m1c)
    n.dev("M2", "x2", "vcm", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2C", "xd", "ibias", "x2", "vss", m1c)
    n.dev("M3", "xd", "xd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "xd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.R("R1", "vin1", "vn", R1)
    n.R("RF", "vn", "vout", Rf)
    n.R("R2", "vin2", "vcm", 1e6)

    vcasc = mb.vgs + mbc.vgs
    vtail = 0.9 - m1.vgs
    vx = vcasc - m1c.vgs
    hr_in = (vx - vtail) - m1.vdsat
    hr_c = (0.9 - vx) - m1c.vdsat

    beta = R1 / (R1 + Rf)
    rdown = (1.0 / m1c.gds) * (1.0 + m1c.gm / m1.gds)
    gout = 1.0 / rdown + m3.gds + 1.0 / (R1 + Rf)
    A = m1.gm / gout
    T = A * beta
    a1 = -(Rf / R1) * T / (1.0 + T)
    cout = cl + m1c.cdd + m3.cdd + m1c.cgd
    bw = (gout + beta * m1.gm) / (2 * PI * cout)
    fnode = 1.0 / (2 * PI * (R1 * Rf / (R1 + Rf)) * (m1.cgg + 5e-15))
    fmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg + m1c.cdd))
    fcas = m1c.gm / (2 * PI * (m1c.cgg + m1.cdd))
    bw = 1.0 / (1.0 / bw + 0.5 / fnode + 0.3 / fmir + 0.3 / fcas)
    vnat = vdd - m3.vgs
    offset = (vnat - 0.9) / A * (1.0 + Rf / R1)
    power = 1.98 * (It + iref)
    return n, {"a1": a1, "bw": bw, "vout_offset": offset, "power": power,
               "hr_in": hr_in, "hr_c": hr_c}
